name: Update Page
description: Update a page's property values. To append page content, use the *Append Block* action instead. [See the documentation](https://developers.notion.com/reference/patch-page)

configurable_props.name: infoLabel
configurable_props.content: Properties that are not set will remain unchanged.

configurable_props.name: parentDataSource
configurable_props.label: Parent Data Source ID
configurable_props.description: Select the data source that contains the page to update. If you instead provide a data source ID in a custom expression, you will also have to provide the page's ID in a custom expression

configurable_props.name: pageId
configurable_props.label: Page ID
configurable_props.description: Search for a page from the data source or provide a page ID

configurable_props.name: archived
configurable_props.label: Archive Page
configurable_props.description: Set to `true` to archive (delete) a page. Set to `false` to  un-archive (restore) a page

configurable_props.name: metaTypes
configurable_props.label: Meta Types
configurable_props.description: Select one or more page attributes (such as icon and cover)

configurable_props.name: propertyTypes
configurable_props.label: Property Types
configurable_props.description: Select one or more page properties
